rubric.role_summary: Backend engineer building supply-chain and logistics services, real-time data pipelines, provider integrations, and data models for order management, tracking, inventory, and fulfillment.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Backend engineer building supply-chain and logistics services, real-time data pipelines, provider integrations, and data models for order management, tracking, inventory, and fulfillment.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of backend engineering experience.
- Strong command of Java (Spring Boot) or equivalent JVM-based frameworks.
- Experience with Kafka, Kinesis, or similar streaming technology.
- Relational database skills.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Backend engineering experience in logistics, supply chain, or operations-intensive domains.
- Python skills.
- Experience designing real-time data ingestion and processing systems, using Kafka, Kinesis, or similar technology.
- Relational database skills and experience modeling complex, interrelated business domains.
- Understanding of distributed-systems trade-offs around consistency, availability, and latency.
- Exposure to third-party API integrations involving legacy or external systems.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Berlin area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
